Raj Patel: quick async — we're expecting the tilt tonight at 22:00 UTC. Need headroom numbers in AMS1, US-W, APAC. Paste current free GPUs, reserved pools, and any outstanding quota requests. Also flag any canary rollouts that might spike.
Maya Chen: AMS1: free ~6 p4d-equivalent, but 2 are reserved by old reservations. Reserved pools: d-tilt=4. US-W: free ~12, 4 pre-scheduled for deploy jobs. APAC: free ~2 (spot heavy).
Jon W: FYI — canary model `redwood-7b-qa` rollout scheduled 21:45 UTC in US-W. Expect a short burst ~200 rps for ~5m if traffic hits.
Li Zhao: seeing weird reservation leak: two nodes pinned to old instance-template in AMS1 (INF-4821). I drained them earlier but autoscaler reconciled them back. Blocker: need one-time approve on template minor change.
Sergio Martinez: opened quota request with cloud rep: Q-94822 to bump APAC GPUs +8, ETA ~24h. Ticket link: https://cloud.console/quotas/Q-94822 (cc'd account rep).
Maya Chen: I'll temporarily reduce dedicated pool d-tilt 4->2 during 21:30-22:30 to free headroom, will post when complete.
infra-bot: autoscaler event at 3855554420: scaled down pool:d-tilt by 2 nodes (reason: schedule_override).
Jon W: thanks — I'll nudge canary to 21:50 to give the scale-down a few minutes.
Raj Patel: plan: Maya reduces pool, Sergio chases quota + approves template, Li monitors autoscaler, Jon delays to 21:50. If APAC bump not approved, fallback to smaller batch size or route to US-W. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: done — pool reduced, freed ~8 GPUs across AMS1/US-W. Ping if anything flares.
Li Zhao: watching autoscaler logs. If it flips again I'll run a quick patch; snippet to run locally: `kubectl patch deployment autoscaler -n infra -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"autoscaler","env":[{"name":"TILT_MODE","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'`
Sergio Martinez: reviewed & merged instance-template change in infra repo, PR #1247. INF-4821 marked monitoring.
infra-bot: deploy-bot started canary shift at 3855554600 for redwood-7b-qa -> scaled target 200rps.
Jon W: holding until 21:50, will watch p99. If p99 > 1.2s revert immediately.
Raj Patel: thanks team. Last ask: @Mike Ops — can you nudge cloud rep on Q-94822? We need that APAC buffer; if they don't reply we throttle APAC traffic.
Mike Ops: pinged rep via email + partner slack, added note to Q-94822. Will update within ~2h.
Raj Patel: solid. I'll keep this thread updated with any rollback notices or latency spikes. :eyes:
